sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface labeling and confocal immunofluorescence confirmed cell-surface display of FLAG-KCNE2; no channel-function assay (e.g. electrophysiology of KCNE2-containing complex) is reported in the cited ledger lines.
sites.rationale: KCNE2 is a single-pass type I membrane protein with no signal peptide; the raw topology string begins with 'O' at residue 1, making the N-terminus the only extracellular terminus. Because no residue number is given in any ledger line, the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue=0 places the tag before M1 (residue_after='M'). L4 independently confirms surface display of the FLAG-tagged construct by surface labeling and confocal IF, elevating validation to surface_only. Multiple independent N-terminal tag constructs (HA in L1, L5, L6; 3xFLAG in L3) across different labs corroborate that this terminus tolerates short epitope tags without disrupting trafficking. Full-length KCNE2 cloned with an N-terminal 3xFLAG tag into p3XFLAG-CMV-10 (FLAG-KCNE2); surface labeling and confocal immunofluorescence in transfected cells confirmed cell-surface display of the tagged protein (L3, L4). Independent N-terminal HA-tagged constructs (HA-E2) in pcDNA3.1(+) were reported in two additional studies (L1; L5/L6), all full-length membrane-anchored protein. No residue number is stated in any ledger line; KCNE2 has no signal peptide (topology begins O at residue 1), so the N-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus and the tag prepends before M1.

sources.claim: The PCR product was cloned into pCR®-Blunt II-TOPO® vector (Invitrogen) and then subcloned into the EcoR1-BamH1 sites of p3XFLAG-CMV-10 vector (Sigma) resulting in a cDNA with N-terminal FLAG tag identical to the KCNE1 construct.

literature_notes: L1 (HA-E2) and L5/L6 (HA-KCNE2 in CHO cells) corroborate the same N-terminal prepend junction as L3; they are the same site and L3+L4 provide the strongest evidence (surface labeling confirmed), so L3 is cited as the primary supporting clip. L2 (KCNE2-EGFP C-terminal fusion) is excluded from sites because the C-terminus falls in the intracellular domain (residues 70-123 per authoritative landmarks) and is therefore not a surface tag site; it is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for KCNE2.

literature_other_positions.note: KCNE2-EGFP C-terminal fusion: EGFP is fused after the last residue (P123), which lies in the intracellular domain (residues 70-123); not accessible on the extracellular face.
